components.name: NumberCountUp
components.description: Counts from `from` to `to`, easing out as it lands. `direction="down"` runs it the other way. Width is held for the longest value, so the text around it never shifts.

props.name: decimals
props.description: Decimal places kept. Defaults to the most in `from` or the target.

props.name: separator
props.description: Replaces the locale's grouping mark. Pass "" to drop it.

props.name: startOnView
props.description: Hold the run until the number scrolls into view.

components.name: NumberFlip
components.description: A split-flap board: each digit sits on its own card and rolls forward, flipping once per number, until it reaches `value`. Changing `value` rolls only the digits that differ.

props.name: separator
props.description: Replaces the locale's grouping mark. Pass "" to drop it.

props.name: decimals
props.description: Decimal places kept. Defaults to the most in `from` or the target.

props.name: startOnView
props.description: Hold the run until the number scrolls into view.

props.name: stepMs
props.description: How long each single flip takes.

components.name: NumberSpeed
components.description: Races a number up to `value`, smearing sideways and stretching while it moves fast, then snapping sharp as it lands.

props.name: decimals
props.description: Decimal places kept. Defaults to the most in `from` or the target.

props.name: separator
props.description: Replaces the locale's grouping mark. Pass "" to drop it.

props.name: startOnView
props.description: Hold the run until the number scrolls into view.

props.name: blurStrength
props.description: How readily speed turns into blur.

props.name: maxBlur
props.description: Upper bound on the blur radius, in pixels.

examples.title: Number Effect
examples.code:
<>
  <TypeCard label="count up">
    <NumberCountUp to={100} />
  </TypeCard>
  <TypeCard label="count down">
    <NumberCountUp from={0} to={10} direction="down" delayMs={400} />
  </TypeCard>
  <TypeCard label="separator">
    <NumberCountUp to={1234567} separator=" " />
  </TypeCard>
  <TypeCard label="decimals">
    <NumberCountUp to={98.6} suffix="°F" />
  </TypeCard>
  <TypeCard label="speed">
    <NumberSpeed value={20000} prefix="$" loop />
  </TypeCard>
  <TypeCard label="speed percent">
    <NumberSpeed value={99.9} suffix="%" />
  </TypeCard>
  <TypeCard label="flip">
    <NumberFlip value={2048} />
  </TypeCard>
  <TypeCard label="flip price">
    <NumberFlip value={1299} prefix="$" />
  </TypeCard>
  <TypeCard label="flip live">
    <FlipTicker />
  </TypeCard>
</>
